title: ardisia glabra
intro: Ardisia glabra, commonly known as Coral Berry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrsinaceae. It is native to tropical regions of Asia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ardisia glabra include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Ardisia glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
